jobs.title: Senior Director of Payments Product
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the role?

Etsy Payments is responsible for providing a delightful and trusted payments experience to our 90MM+ buyers and 5MM+ active sellers. Etsy Payments processes over $10B of volume/year across 60 countries and 20 currencies. As Senior Director of Payments Product, you will lead the product team that enables Etsy to accept the payment methods that our buyers trust, provide frictionless buyer checkout, and ensure that payments reliably work. You will also lead the teams that ensure sellers can see their financial transactions, receive timely payouts, and seamlessly complete tax and compliance requirements. You will set the vision for the Payments team and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Legal to build trusted payment experiences across every channel where Etsy listings appear — in-person, social, and agentic commerce.

This is a full-time position reporting to the VP, Marketplace Trust.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

The Payments Product Team Operates At The Intersection Of Trust, Growth, And Financial Infrastructure. The Team Is Organized Into Five Specialized Squads, Each With Deep Ownership Over a Distinct Dimension Of The Payments Experience

Buyer Payment Experience focuses on how buyers pay — from checkout conversion and alternative payment method (APM) expansion (Apple Pay, Affirm, Revolut, CashApp) to guest checkout optimization and payment-related messaging.
Money Movement works on the infrastructure that keeps payments flowing: authorization rate optimization, decline reattempts, payout redundancy and the path to 100% EP100 uptime, and launching new payment rails globally.
Payments & Seller Compliance owns Etsy's regulatory and compliance obligations — seller identity verification, PCI compliance, and fraud-adjacent risk controls that protect both the marketplace and its sellers.
Seller Financial Experience owns what it feels like to be a seller managing money on Etsy: financial holds, payment account design, manual billing, and the seller ledger — tools used by millions of sellers worldwide.
Tax manages Etsy's global tax obligations, navigating marketplace facilitator laws, withholding tax, import fees, digital services tax, and 1099 reporting — in a regulatory landscape that never stops shifting.

The culture is rigorous and collaborative. PMs run tight discovery cycles, work closely with stakeholders from day one, and are always expected to always keep the customer at the heart of their work.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Setting and evolving multi-year payments strategy — translating Etsy's North Star of accelerating the marketplace flywheel through trusted financial experiences into quarterly roadmaps across five squads.
Representing Payments in senior cross-functional forums with Legal, Finance, Accounting, and the exec team — on issues ranging from tax policy and regulatory response to payment network relationships and financial risk.
Driving high-stakes product decisions: for example, weighing in on which payment methods to launch next and in which markets, how to design financial holds in ways that don't erode seller trust, and how to balance auth rate interventions with COR.
Managing regulatory and compliance timelines with real financial consequences — including seller reverification programs protecting hundreds of millions in exposure, 1099 infrastructure, withholding tax implementations, and evolving digital sales tax requirements across multiple countries.
Hiring, developing, and retaining product managers across IC and manager levels; coaching squad leads on navigating ambiguity, sizing trade-offs, and running effective discovery.
Serving as connective tissue between Payments and the broader Marketplace: ensuring buyer-facing checkout improvements, seller financial tools, and platform investments reinforce each other and ladder to company goals.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

10+ years building and scaling product teams in payments, fintech, or financial services with at least 4 years of managing Product Managers
Deep experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure — with working knowledge of payment rails, authorization flows, compliance frameworks (PCI, KYC/AML), and/or tax obligations
Proven ability to set multi-year product strategy and translate it into executable roadmaps across large, cross-functional teams
Track record of shipping complex, high-stakes products in regulated environments — balancing growth objectives with legal, compliance, and risk constraints
Strong financial acumen; able to model trade-offs, size opportunities, and present confidently to senior finance and legal stakeholders
Experience working across global markets, including navigating varying regulatory requirements by geography
Exceptional cross-functional influence — comfortable leading without authority across Engineering, Legal, Finance, Design, and Operations

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 283,000.00 - 383,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 255,000.00 - 345,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. What's the role?

Etsy Payments is responsible for providing a delightful and trusted payments experience to our 90MM+ buyers and 5MM+ active sellers. Etsy Payments processes over $10B of volume/year across 60 countries and 20 currencies. As Senior Director of Payments Product, you will lead the product team that enables Etsy to accept the payment methods that our buyers trust, provide frictionless buyer checkout, and ensure that payments reliably work. You will also lead the teams that ensure sellers can see their financial transactions, receive timely payouts, and seamlessly complete tax and compliance requirements. You will set the vision for the Payments team and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Legal to build trusted payment experiences across every channel where Etsy listings appear — in-person, social, and agentic commerce.

This is a full-time position reporting to the VP, Marketplace Trust.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

The Payments Product Team Operates At The Intersection Of Trust, Growth, And Financial Infrastructure. The Team Is Organized Into Five Specialized Squads, Each With Deep Ownership Over a Distinct Dimension Of The Payments Experience

Buyer Payment Experience focuses on how buyers pay — from checkout conversion and alternative payment method (APM) expansion (Apple Pay, Affirm, Revolut, CashApp) to guest checkout optimization and payment-related messaging.
Money Movement works on the infrastructure that keeps payments flowing: authorization rate optimization, decline reattempts, payout redundancy and the path to 100% EP100 uptime, and launching new payment rails globally.
Payments & Seller Compliance owns Etsy's regulatory and compliance obligations — seller identity verification, PCI compliance, and fraud-adjacent risk controls that protect both the marketplace and its sellers.
Seller Financial Experience owns what it feels like to be a seller managing money on Etsy: financial holds, payment account design, manual billing, and the seller ledger — tools used by millions of sellers worldwide.
Tax manages Etsy's global tax obligations, navigating marketplace facilitator laws, withholding tax, import fees, digital services tax, and 1099 reporting — in a regulatory landscape that never stops shifting.

The culture is rigorous and collaborative. PMs run tight discovery cycles, work closely with stakeholders from day one, and are always expected to always keep the customer at the heart of their work.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Setting and evolving multi-year payments strategy — translating Etsy's North Star of accelerating the marketplace flywheel through trusted financial experiences into quarterly roadmaps across five squads.
Representing Payments in senior cross-functional forums with Legal, Finance, Accounting, and the exec team — on issues ranging from tax policy and regulatory response to payment network relationships and financial risk.
Driving high-stakes product decisions: for example, weighing in on which payment methods to launch next and in which markets, how to design financial holds in ways that don't erode seller trust, and how to balance auth rate interventions with COR.
Managing regulatory and compliance timelines with real financial consequences — including seller reverification programs protecting hundreds of millions in exposure, 1099 infrastructure, withholding tax implementations, and evolving digital sales tax requirements across multiple countries.
Hiring, developing, and retaining product managers across IC and manager levels; coaching squad leads on navigating ambiguity, sizing trade-offs, and running effective discovery.
Serving as connective tissue between Payments and the broader Marketplace: ensuring buyer-facing checkout improvements, seller financial tools, and platform investments reinforce each other and ladder to company goals.

Job Title

Vice President of Product Design

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

The position is accountable for establishing a strong design vision, improving customer experience, accelerating product innovation, and building a world-class product design organization.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Master's degree or advanced qualification in Design, HCI, Product Development, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18 years of experience in product design, UX/UI, interaction design, industrial design, design research, or related fields, including 8+ years in senior design leadership positions.

Proven track record of leading product design organizations and developing successful products or digital experiences.

Strong experience in design strategy, user research, design systems, product development, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams across multiple products, platforms, or markets.

Experience working closely with C-suite executives, Product leaders, Engineering teams, Marketing organizations, customers, and external partners preferred.

International or multi-market product design experience strongly preferred.

Strong design leadership, strategic thinking, customer empathy, creative problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.

About PHOENIX

PHOENIX Retail, LLC is a retail platform operating the Express and Bonobos brands worldwide.

About Express

Express is a multichannel apparel brand dedicated to a design philosophy rooted in modern, confident and effortless style whether dressing for work, everyday or special occasions. Since its launch in 1980, the brand has embraced a design philosophy rooted in modern, confident and effortless style. Express ensures you look and feel your best, wherever life takes you. The Company operates over 400 retail and outlet stores in the United States and Puerto Rico, the express.com online store and the Express mobile app.

About Bonobos

Our Bonobos menswear brand is known for being a style instigator and offering perfect-fit risks through our innovative retail model and personalized experience. Launched online in 2007 with its signature line of chinos, Bonobos now offers a variety of styles available to order online and to try on at any one of our 50 Guideshop locations and at www.bonobos.com. Our Guideshops are in-real-life stores that deliver one-on-one service and expert fit advice. Don't think traditional retail, Bonobos is something you haven't seen before.

Location Name

Columbus Corporate Headquarters

Responsibilities

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior Product Manager, Digital will serve as the key architect of the end-to-end customer journey across Express and Bonobos, synthesizing web, mobile, and physical store touchpoints-including retail locations and Bonobos Guideshops-into a cohesive omnichannel ecosystem. Operating at the intersection of technology, data science, merchandising, and digital operations, you will define and execute the strategic roadmap for core commerce funnels, customer acquisition, loyalty platforms, and post-purchase pathways. By collaborating with Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing teams, you will leverage both traditional product management frameworks and AI-powered personalization (such as semantic search and recommendation engines) to build scalable, high-conversion features that drive customer retention, brand loyalty, and measurable growth across both brands.

Key Responsibilities
Visionary Roadmap Development: Establish a long-range strategy for AI-driven personalization. Manage a complex framework utilizing proprietary datasets, machine learning models, and external technology solutions to optimize customer LTV, retention, and acquisition.
System Architecture & Deployment: Oversee the full lifecycle of recommendation engines across digital platforms, such as mobile apps, email, and commerce pages (Cart, PLP, PDP, and homepage). Engineer filtering and ranking logic to boost conversion rates and product visibility.
Customer Acquisition & Funnel Conversion: Drive continuous conversion rate optimization (CRO) across landing pages, product listing pages (PLPs), search discovery, and the shopping cart. Own the global checkout architecture to minimize purchase friction and increase Average Order Value (AOV).
Loyalty, Retention & Lifecycle Messaging: Lead the product strategy for digital loyalty programs and account portals. Partner with CRM and Marketing teams to leverage marketing automation platforms (email, SMS, and push notifications) to deliver targeted customer lifecycle campaigns that increase customer retention and Lifetime Value (LTV).
Post-Purchase Experience & Operations: Own the digital customer experience from order confirmation to doorstep delivery. Define the roadmap for transaction tracking, shipping alerts, order routing, and modern omnichannel fulfillment pathways like Buy Online, Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Curbside Pickup, and Ship-to-Store.
Vendor Ecosystem & Strategic Sourcing: Actively evaluate, pilot, and manage third-party software vendors (e.g., search engines, payment gateways, review platforms, loyalty engines, and CRM systems). Run structured RFPs and Proof of Concept (PoC) tests to balance proprietary builds against external integrations.
Experimentation & Growth Culture: Establish a rigorous culture of experimentation. Plan, launch, and analyze systematic A/B and multivariate tests spanning acquisition pages, checkout variants, post-purchase flows, and lifecycle campaigns to validate customer value and financial return.
Efficiency & Return Mitigation: Utilize AI/ML to minimize product returns-specifically those related to fit-extending personalization beyond top-line revenue. Prioritize LTV cohorts and return reduction as core success metrics.
Business Case Modeling & Stakeholder Alignment: Translate complex technological initiatives and platform performance metrics into clear, executive-friendly business cases and financial metrics (CAC, LTV, Conversion, Return Rate Reduction) to align senior leadership across the Phoenix brands.

Required Experience & Qualifications
Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, IT, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 7+ years of Digital Product Management experience, with a proven track record of owning consumer-facing eCommerce products, AI/ML-powered search relevance and recommendation systems, customer checkout funnels, loyalty platforms, or digital marketing technologies.
Retail/Omnichannel Context: Prior background working in retail eCommerce, multi-brand consumer platforms, or omnichannel environments (such as integrating physical point-of-sale systems with digital profiles) is highly preferred.
Frictionless Execution: Demonstrated success scaling digital products from pilot to high-volume coverage, resulting in measurable customer conversion gains or transactional efficiency.
Analytical and Results-Driven: Mastery of data-driven decision-making, using web analytics (e.g., GA4), customer metrics (CAC, AOV, LTV), and statistical hypothesis testing (A/B testing).
Collaborative Leadership: Outstanding communication skills with a proven capacity to lead and align cross-functional teams of Software Engineers, UI/UX Designers, Data Analysts, and business stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
Platform Familiarity: Familiarity with modern eCommerce platforms, Order Management Systems (OMS), Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), or content management system (CMS) integrations.
Advanced Personalization & AI/ML Expertise: Possess a deep understanding of varied personalization strategies, including hybrid models, content-based filtering, and collaborative techniques alongside modern AI/ML methodologies.

Operated with high autonomy and incomplete information, contributing from week one
Communicated effectively in writing and in person across Engineering, Risk, Legal/Compliance, Finance, Data, and Operations

Brought Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent-level product management experience
